record.original_question: Let M(c2)=MH((2,0,c2)) be the moduli scheme of rank-two H-stable sheaves on a surface X with Chern classes (2,0,c2). Are all singularities of M(c2) canonical?

evidence.quote: Now we denote MH ((2, 0, c2 )) = M (c2 ) = M .
Problem 1.4. Are all singularities of M (c2 ) canonical or not?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth projective surface over $\mathbb{C}$ equipped with an ample divisor $H$. For a coherent sheaf $E$ on $X$, recall that $E$ is Gieseker $H$-stable if for every nonzero proper subsheaf $F\subset E$ one has
$$\frac{\chi(F\otimes\mathcal{O}_X(nH))}{\operatorname{rk}(F)} < \frac{\chi(E\otimes\mathcal{O}_X(nH))}{\operatorname{rk}(E)}\quad\text{for }n\gg 0.$$
Let
$$M(c_2)\;:=\;M_H\bigl((2,0,c_2)\bigr)$$
denote the moduli scheme parametrizing $S$-equivalence classes of $H$-stable torsion-free coherent sheaves $E$ on $X$ of rank $2$ with Chern classes $c_1(E)=0$ and $c_2(E)=c_2\in\mathbb{Z}$.

A normal variety $Y$ is said to have only canonical singularities if $Y$ is $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein and, for some (equivalently every) resolution of singularities $f:\widetilde Y\to Y$, the discrepancies in
$$K_{\widetilde Y}\;=\;f^{*}K_Y+\sum a_i E_i$$
satisfy $a_i\geq 0$ for every $f$-exceptional divisor $E_i$.

Question: For an arbitrary such pair $(X,H)$ and integer $c_2$ for which $M(c_2)$ is non-empty, are all singularities of the moduli scheme $M(c_2)$ canonical?
artifact.category_tag: Moduli of stable sheaves on surfaces
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a survey on birational properties and singularities of moduli schemes of rank-two stable sheaves on surfaces. Related results (e.g., work of O'Grady, Kaledin–Lehn–Sorger, and Sacca on K3 and Enriques surfaces) establish symplectic/canonical singularity properties in special cases, but no general resolution covering arbitrary surfaces was found.

status_evidence.title: Singularities of moduli spaces of sheaves on K3 surfaces and Nakajima quiver varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Studies symplectic/canonical singularities of moduli of sheaves on K3 surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for specific surface classes, but no general statement covering arbitrary smooth projective surfaces with arbitrary c_2.

status_evidence.title: Singularities and Kodaira dimension of moduli scheme of stable sheaves on Enriques surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates singularities of moduli of rank-two stable sheaves on Enriques surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Related investigations addressing the same kind of question only for special surfaces.
